시방카 (시바견 차) 가질려면 30로벅스 내야함 특징:방귀부스터 (속도:8/10 지구력:8/10)

그룹가입: 사자도리카 특징: 갈기로 악어도리카 물기 공격 막기 (속도:5/10 지구력:10/10) or 악어도리카 물기 (속도:9/10 지구력:4/10

좋아요 누르면 시방오토바이. (시바견 오토바이) 특징: 방귀 부스터 (속도:8/10 지구력:6/10)

친구 초대하면 코닉세그. 특징: 비행기 엔진으로 하늘 날기 (속도: 7/10 지구력: 3/10)

나머지 차: F1 cars. (모두 속도와 지구력: 1/10과 1/10


게임이름: battle of the racing cars (레이싱카들의 대결)

레이싱 코스: 5가지 1:탕후루 asmr course 2:두쫀쿠 asmr course 3:팝잇 asmr course 4:왁뿌볼 asmr course 5:키캡 asmr course
게임이름: battle of the racing cars (레이싱카들의 대결)

answers.ask: Are these lap circuits or point-to-point sprints? Nothing in the prompt says whether a race is timed laps or a single run.
answers.answer: 각 ASMR 코스는 한 바퀴를 도는 랩 서킷으로 만들고, 레이스는 1랩 완주 방식으로 해주세요.

answers.ask: How long should one lap be, given the cars range from very fast to very slow?
answers.answer: 한 랩은 작은 맵에서 약 1~2분 안에 완주할 수 있는 짧은 길이로 해주세요.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D racing game map collection for Battle of the Racing Cars, with five separate compact one-lap circuit courses designed to be completed in roughly 1–2 minutes each. Build a tanghulu ASMR course, a chewy chocolate-cookie ASMR course, a pop-it ASMR course, a wax-bubble-ball ASMR course, and a keycap ASMR course; each track forms a closed loop through oversized props and themed surfaces associated with its ASMR material.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Racing: each course is a competitive, one-lap vehicle circuit. There is no secondary genre; the ASMR themes dress the tracks rather than define play.

### Shape and preset
Use the Racing shape `route-circuit`. This is five separate closed-loop circuits, each compact enough for a full lap in roughly 1–2 minutes. Match the Circuit Racing preset for its continuous circuit logic, but retain only the explicitly required route markings and one-lap completion elements; omit unrequested starting grids, guardrails, and stands.

### Config requirements
`lane-corridor` is visible geometry: clearly delineate the drivable route around every loop with themed edge markings and readable track surfaces. `startpoint-line` is both visible and invisible: each circuit has one clearly marked start line and its associated start position. `trigger-finish` is both visible and invisible: place the finish detection at the start/finish line for the single completed lap. `trigger-lap` is invisible: a lap-check region verifies progression around each closed loop and must not appear in the render.

### Layout components
Build five separate compact course maps: Tanghulu ASMR, chewy chocolate-cookie ASMR, pop-it ASMR, wax-bubble-ball ASMR, and keycap ASMR. Each map is one continuous, non-self-crossing loop with a shared start/finish straight and a short, readable route through oversized props associated with its material. Tanghulu uses giant glossy candied fruit skewers and syrup-like surfaces; the cookie course uses oversized chewy chocolate-cookie forms and crumb-textured ground; pop-it uses large silicone bubble grids and bright circular impressions; wax-bubble-ball uses rounded waxy spheres and pooled, smooth material forms; keycap uses oversized keyboard keys, key rows, and mechanical-looking gaps as scenery. Keep all props outside or alongside the drivable corridor rather than obscuring it. Each course is self-contained by themed outer scenery and track-edge treatment, with no connection between maps. Compose each plan with the full loop legible at a glance and the start/finish straight prominent near the foreground.

### Render order
Use `authored_plan`: a racing circuit must be valid by construction, with one closed, connected, non-ambiguous route before its themed props are dressed.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium overall: it is a collection of five small maps, each sized for a 1–2 minute lap. Theme is playful, colorful, toy-scale ASMR material fantasy. Use `P4` because the five courses are separate maps, and `P6` because every circuit route must be continuous and valid by construction.
